name: DWD: warnings by municipality (Germany)

frame.part: top of the page, no scrolling

capture_note: Not captured yet: asked of incident.archivist@ on 11 November 2026 (the callouts stand on this agent's own render; the frame stays empty and the link stands).
licence_for_showing_the_screenshot: The map prints "Copyright: © Deutscher Wetterdienst". DWD's own terms for showing a screenshot have not been read by us yet: until they are, the frame stays empty and only the link is given.
summary: The state of the country in two words in the header of every page ("KEINE UNWETTERWARNUNG"), a map down to the municipality with the time it was last updated above it, a legend with the four levels in words, and under it the warning situation written out and timed by the forecasting centre. On this night it showed level 1 (yellow) over parts of the north and east and nothing higher.

callouts.title: The state now, in the header
callouts.does_well: "KEINE UNWETTERWARNUNG" (no severe-weather warning) sits in the top bar beside the temperature of the reader's place, on every page.
callouts.fed_by: incidents/2026-11-10-storm-charles/data/weather/warnings.json (Lisbon's highest level in force, in IPMA's words)

callouts.title: Last updated, and it refreshes itself
callouts.does_well: "Letzte Aktualisierung: Mi, 11. Nov, 03:39 Uhr" above the map, with a ticked box "Autom. Aktualisierung".

callouts.title: A place first
callouts.does_well: One search box above the map ("Bitte Ort eingeben"): the warning text is shown for the place typed or the area clicked.
callouts.fed_by: not ours yet: one district only (Lisbon)

callouts.title: The map, municipality by municipality
callouts.does_well: Green where there is no warning, yellow for level 1: the areas are municipalities, far smaller than districts, with the main cities named.
callouts.fed_by: our own redraw from IPMA's JSON; IPMA warns by district

callouts.title: Kinds of hazard as buttons
callouts.does_well: A column of icon buttons beside the map, ending in "alle" (all), redraws it for one kind of hazard; two more below for the coast.

callouts.title: The levels in words, and a step before a warning
callouts.does_well: Four levels named and numbered (Stufe 1 to 4, "Wetterwarnungen" to "Warnungen vor extremem Unwetter"), "Keine Warnungen" as its own colour, and a hatched "Vorabinformation Unwetter": advance information before a warning is issued.
callouts.fed_by: IPMA's own description of its four levels, quoted and linked

callouts.title: The situation, written and timed
callouts.does_well: "Beschreibung der Warnlage Deutschland", issued Wednesday 11.11.2026, 04:01 local time: two sentences (ice, fog, light frost), signed by the forecasting centre in Offenbach.

limits: No severe-weather warning was in force in Germany, so levels 2 to 4 and a warning's own text were not seen. At the first attempt (11 November, about 02:50 UTC) this page drew without its stylesheet; this is the second.
